plan.title: What changed
items: New draft 1F = 1D with your four notes. 1D kept to compare.
'Grumpy' once; the old lady states the food problem flatly and says 'Perhaps we should vote' (your words); no hands, straight to 'The next day.'

plan.title: The film: why it is hard
items: A video from an AI is weak evidence: it builds simulations (Derek even asks in scene D, 'How do I know this isn't one of your simulations?'). So the film can't just assert; it has to show something they can check, or something only real could show.
Four ways to make it convincing, mixable:

plan.title: F1 · It is their own door
items: The recording is the kill bot's own eyes racing at THEIR door: their faded sign, the moss on the blast doors, the tannoy horn, Maddie in frame. Timestamp: twenty minutes ago. Someone mouths 'that's us'. Recognition makes it real, and it's the footage the audience already saw, so it costs nothing.

plan.title: F2 · The objective rewrites itself
items: On the HUD, KILL MODE; then the objective line is struck through and retyped letter by letter: ELIMINATE ORGANIC SIGNAL → SUSTAIN ORGANIC LIFE. The bots turn away. Slow enough to read; the hundred read it with us.

plan.title: F3 · They check it themselves
items: The film ends; Derek goes up to the old periscope (Cold War bunkers had them) and looks out: the track marks lead away, and out in the field one kill bot sits powered down, a bird landing on it. Proof the AI didn't make. One new still + clip, and it gives Derek his grumpy, silent turn.

plan.title: F4 · Sustain organic life, demonstrated
items: The film's last shot: a kill bot stopping dead for a hedgehog crossing its track, then going round it. Funny, tender, and it shows the new objective in action. Risk: cute; and the AI could fake it, so it works best after F1.

plan.title: You decide
items: Pick 1F (or note lines), then the film: I'd do F1 + F2 inside the film, then F3 after it. About 14 s, no words. Stills are free; I'll make options for the periscope and the faces for you to approve before any video credit.

replies.1-1D-L9: Agreed, it's the beat the whole bridge rests on. Four options at the top (F1-F4); my pick is F1 + F2 in the film, then F3, Derek at the periscope seeing it for real.
